what: The Intro's first view: chapter 01 of the introduction, Desert Willow's battery site at night, drawn without its caption, scope line or leader plates. Positions are schematic, as in the story.

code.note: packages/world at 5e68214 is main's, plus the lab's plates=0 option and render.mjs's --plates and --raw

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh 15192, then node scripts/render.mjs --port 15192 --frames opening.pad --out <dir> --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max
render.deterministic: 4 draws in fresh pages (two runs of --repeat 2), byte-identical

png_1920.size: 1920 x 1080, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_2880.size: 2880 x 1620, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: chapter 01 changes: packages/world/src/stations/opening/**, its kit parts, or the frame data
